claims.claim: Committing FAIL_FAST before cancelBoundWork preserves a listener's chance to fix the cause; reversing the order changes attribution.
A cancellation that wins first fixes the token state and cause; later transitions must not rewrite it. The bind race test uses two latches to release cancellation paths together.
claims.note: Latch-gated race test; a mutation for the state CAS is still desirable.

claims.claim: The completedTasks increment must stay last so a converging thread sees the classification, cascade, and fail-fast before it counts a task.
The range check and getAndIncrement are separate; the cancellation getAndSet(size) can leave a phantom index. Removing the range guard must make the stress test observe an index past the end.
claims.note: The test hammers 3000 rounds because the interleaving cannot be gated externally.

claims.claim: Reading count before head.next provides the happens-before edge to a concurrent enqueue; reversing the reads can produce a spurious null.
claims.note: JMM claim; a single-threaded or latch test does not exercise the reordering. Needs jcstress or a JMM-aware harness.

claims.claim: Startup preparation, binds, and submission are one admission against close; removing the admission counter must let a close race the startup and be detected by the runtime tests.
finishCombined waits out the observation publication barrier; removing the observationsReady wait must make the publication-barrier test fail.

mutations.replace: // publication wait removed by the race-claim harness

claims.claim: A true awaitBodyCompletion result must wait until every member observation future carries the final snapshot; removing the observation loop must make a test fail.
claims.note: This claim is separate from the TaskBatch finishCombined path.
